title: Telling the time
summary: The time, at a time, half past, and how long something takes.

hodyna.sentenceGloss: Excuse me, what time is it?

kotra.sentenceGloss: Tell me, please, what time is it? — Seven.

persha.note: Nominative, a feminine ordinal: it agrees with годи́на.

syoma.note: Nominative, a feminine ordinal: it agrees with годи́на.

ob.note: Before a vowel, о becomes об.

kotrii.sentenceGloss: Tell me, at what time does the concert start? — At seven.

rivno.sentenceGloss: The concert is at two p.m. sharp.

tretyu.note: Accusative after на, and the hour ahead: 2:30 is пів на тре́тю.

pershu.note: Accusative after на, and the hour ahead: 2:30 is пів на тре́тю.

khvylyn.sentenceGloss: The train arrives in five minutes.
